acceptance: Inside a wait, both pending wordings for the current head count as waiting
A stopped review, open findings, a pending message for another head and a gate error are still refused
context: 2026-11-12: PR #4155 open (head 0ba4fe3d31, branch fix/pr-arm-wait-pending-verdict-new-format, worktree /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox.wt-fix-pr-arm-wait-new-format). Its own wait kept waiting on the current wording through eight polls, then hit a slow-runner would-block; re-measured with make pr-rerun. Claim released while CI runs; same session resumes.
description: `make pr-arm WAIT=<minutes>` (PR #4110) keeps waiting on a pending review verdict, but `_review_verdict_pending` in scripts/pr_arm.py excluded any gate message starting 'Waiting for review-verdict', assuming that wording meant an owner action. The pinned reviewer now posts exactly that for the ordinary no-verdict-yet state (status_text.gate_waiting: "Waiting for review-verdict · owner bypass: 'Stand-in review: APPROVE <head>'"), so a wait started before the verdict arrives is refused immediately. Seen 2026-11-12 on #4146 and #4144. The state that needs a person is a different message (GATE_NOT_REVIEWED: 'Waiting · not reviewed yet · see the review-verdict status · owner may post a stand-in'), posted when the reviewer stopped; it is cleared with a `/review` comment.
